name: XF06 cross-family missing-value marker table
owner: orchestrator (c_src/common/); no family builder edits it; parsers load it as a named input (path + sha256, F8-R2-19)
source_rule: XF06 and every marker, blank and missing-key reference in every c_src/*/G0_SPEC.md (COMMIT, F1-F13), re-read on 3 Oct 2026 at about 20:20 UTC; the specs read are pinned by sha256 under built_from. Human-readable copy: c_src/common/MARKERS.md
status: G0 closed lexicon (XF17): it passes the 7.2 Claude-seed decontamination and the counts-only sealed template compare before any use

built_from.rule: each spec's sha256 when its XF06 / marker / blank / missing-key references were last re-read for this table. test_markers.py fails when a spec has changed since: re-read that spec's references, update the table and MARKERS.md, then record the new sha256 (never refresh the sha256 alone)

matching.unit: the whole cell, field or value after trimming outer whitespace; a marker is never matched as a substring of a longer value
matching.case: insensitive for word markers ('Not recorded', 'NOT RECORDED' and 'not recorded' are one marker; 'N/A' and 'n/a' are one banned marker)
matching.typed: JSON/YAML null and false are typed values (JSON null / false in this file); a quoted string 'null' or 'false' is not the typed value
matching.phrase_forms: a word marker may also sit in a sentence that states it of one value, e.g. '<fact> was not recorded' (F8 SEM-03, F11 SEM-04)

unknown.meaning: the value exists but the record does not give it; never decisive unless the card says how to decide (default, NEI, exclusion)

zero_or_absent.meaning: zero, no item, or a Boolean fact recorded as not holding

banned.meaning: never a value in any family, in any container (G3 / lint reject)
banned.note: same_marker_forms are the case and dash variants of the XF06 words (F6: 'any dash'); they add no new class

blank.what: an empty cell, an empty string, or a key-value line with nothing after ': '
blank.rule: card-defined only: a blank appears only on rows whose card states what it means (a definition-following contrast)
blank.closed_or_local_cards: a blank is never an unknown; unknowns use a word marker or null, so a blank on a complete record means none/no (or another card-stated value that is not an unknown: 'no change', '<default>', 'no edge')
blank.open_world_cards: a blank may mean unknown if the card says so

missing_key.rule: XF06 is silent; a left-out JSON/YAML key or record field is card-defined per family, as listed under families (open item M4 in MARKERS.md, narrowed in v1.1)

rendering.yaml_null: null (never '~' and never an empty scalar; F9 1.6, F7 3.1)
rendering.yaml_strings: every word marker that YAML 1.1 would coerce ('no', 'yes', 'on', 'off', 'none' stays a string only if quoted) is quoted, or written as the typed value it means (F9 1.6)

COMMIT.uses_notes: '0' added and '0' removed for a binary or mode-only file in the numstat, never git's '-' (1.3)
COMMIT.blank: none (commit rows carry no missing-value markers)
COMMIT.missing_key: not used (no records with optional keys)
refs: 1.3 numstat: binary and mode-only files show 0 / 0, never '-'
XF06 effect: the parser enforces the shared table on any rendered stats or record field

F1.uses_notes: 'not recorded' only on listed non-Boolean fields of missing-field cards, <= 2 per case, in its Unknown class (A10, F1R3-K4); 'no' / false for a known-false Boolean in tables, forms and key-value records on closed-world and missing-field cards
F1.blank: never: open-world case files are prose only, so an open-world unknown is simply not mentioned (F1R3-K3)
F1.missing_key: never an unknown: on closed-world and missing-field cards a record leaves out a key only for a false Boolean (= false, row 1); non-Boolean keys are never left out (F1R3-K3; F1's answer to M4, X6)
refs: 2 case: missing values per case (0-2; F1R2-K3), known-false Booleans, left-out keys (F1R3-K3)

F2.uses_notes: 'not recorded': exactly one rule-read field per open-world row, the literal text in every container (JSON and YAML: the string); closed world: an absent value is left out or printed as '0', 'no' or false (R3-11)
F2.blank: card-defined only: M3 blank amounts (closed-world cards, the named amount column, on a line with no quantity and no rate) and B1 edge blanks; open-world cards have no blank amount cell (R3-07, R3-11)
card_defined_blank: M3 (closed world only): 'A blank cell in the <amount> column means nothing was charged on that line' (= 0)
B1: 'A blank edge cell means the band has no edge on that side'
other_card_markers: <computed-cell marker> (M4: a computed amount, not a missing value; never blank, never read as 0)
F2.missing_key: closed world: an absent line item, condition or W3 field is left out (JSON/YAML: no key) = absent (W1: 0 or false) or the W3 default; open world: never for a field a rule reads (W2, R3-11)
stricter_bans: a blank other than M3 or B1
refs: 2.1 rendering of absent and unknown values (R3-11)

F3.uses_notes: '0' only for a zero <quantity> (rule 20; T17, T39)
F3.local_notes: an unknown arises only from open-world gaps (T2), never from a marker; no pack value (status, code, meaning, swapped word, name, ID) is or contains an XF06 marker word (rule 5, F3-R3-07)
F3.blank: card-defined only (T8: no change; T9 / T42 / B17: a creation blank starts as '<default>'), on rows whose card states it (short cards always do; no-card rows show no blank); tables write an empty cell, JSON / YAML / key-value a left-out key; the opening register has no blank (rule 20; R3-06, R3-C1)
card_defined_blank: T8: 'An entry changes only the fields it names. A blank field means "no change".' (JSON, YAML, key-value: 'A field left out of an entry is a blank field.')
T9 / B17: a field a creation leaves blank starts as '<default>'
T42: 'A blank cell means no change; in a creation row it means the starting value "<default>".'
other_card_markers: <gap marker> (T3: one or more missing log entries; open explicit-marker cards)
F3.missing_key: JSON, YAML and key-value entries: a left-out key is a blank, as the card's T8 sentence states (no change, or '<default>' in a creation; rule 20, F3-R3-06)

F4.uses_notes: OW tables and CSV write an unknown cell as 'not recorded' (legend 2); OW JSON and YAML use null or a missing key (legend 3); never a blank (R4-C3)
F4.blank: only in a column that a record line declares complete (column closure, clause 18c), where it means No; an unknown cell is never blank; CW tables have no blanks (R4-C3)
card_defined_blank: column closure (a record line next to its table, never a card line; 18c): 'the <C> column is complete: a blank <C> cell means No'
F4.missing_key: OW JSON/YAML: a missing key or null = not recorded (unknown) (clause 18 legend 3); CW containers: none that a rule reads
stricter_bans: a blank cell outside a closed column

F5.uses_notes: 'not recorded' or null = some value the record does not give, on a complete record too (SEM-04); 'no' for a yes/no entry
F5.blank: card-defined (SEM-04): on an open card a blank entry = unknown; on a complete record only a yes/no blank, = no; a number, date or category is never blank on a closed card
card_defined_blank: SEM-04 open card: a blank entry means the same as 'not recorded' (unknown)
SEM-04 complete record: a blank yes/no entry means no
F5.missing_key: closed cards: never (every key, field and number / date / category attribute is rendered; G3 rejects an omission; F5-R3-07); open cards: an attribute the text does not mention is unstated, so unknown (SEM-03)

F6.local_notes: S5 dialogue only: the markers its card lists, matched whole
F6.blank: a blank cell = unknown on open-world tables only; closed and local cards print no blank cell
F6.missing_key: JSON/YAML: a missing key = no entry (closes where the card closes that fact type, unknown otherwise); banned inside row-42 tables and member lists
stricter_bans: any marker containing a plan word ('will check')

F7.blank: card-defined: not present (= absent), Boolean fields only (C15)
card_defined_blank: C15: a blank cell, an empty string or a left-out key counts as not present (0 points); Boolean fields only

F8.blank: never (no empty cells, in either world)
F8.missing_key: only for a Boolean factor in a closed-world row, where it means absent; never for numbers
stricter_bans: a missing key for a number

a record-status word ('record' or 'log' in any form, 'on file', 'documented', 'registered', 'reported') outside the two 'not recorded' marker forms and the SEM-01 to SEM-03 card lines that define them (F8-R4-06)

F9.uses_notes: UNKNOWN (T3 null token): 'not recorded' or 'unknown' in table, CSV, fixed-width and key-value containers, null in JSON / YAML; '0' is a real zero

boolean_tokens.note: T34 closed set (R3-SC1): true / false (typed in JSON / YAML, the words elsewhere) or '1' / '0' (non-JSON / YAML only). The false tokens are the zero-or-absent class; 'true' and '1' are in no marker class. F9 registers no family-local marker

F9.blank: never (no blank cells, empty CSV fields, empty strings or empty 'key:')
F9.missing_key: never an unknown: non-T6 cards: never used (every record shows every field; G3 rejects a missing key); T6 cards (S4): the field's stated default (T3, T6; R3-SC3, X6)

F10.uses_notes: open world: one omission marker per format style ('not recorded', 'unknown', null, or a left-out key), named in the card's ST5 sentence; '0', 'no', 'none' and false are stated values (ST6); closed world states false flags ('no') and empty tag sets ('none')
F10.local_notes: 'not listed' (ST4) only inside a stated tag list
F10.blank: never (table containers use a word marker)
F10.missing_key: open world, key-value / JSON / YAML / prose containers only: a left-out key can be the style's one omission marker (unknown), named in ST5; never in table containers

F11.uses_notes: not stated in records = a missing key or column, null, 'unknown' or 'not recorded', only on cards with a missing rule for that attribute (SEM-50, S4 renders)
F11.local_notes: 'not checked' (with 'not recorded', 'unknown') = not stated only in report text on SEM-03/04 cards (SEM-05, A19); never a field value or a value term (R35, F11-R3-13). Record fields (SEM-50): 'yes', 'true', true or one of the attribute's listed terms = present; 'no', 'false', false or 'none' = absent; 'none' in a set field = the empty set (SEM-47, F11-R2-04). 'present', 'absent' and 'not stated' are card words or statuses only, never written in a report or record (SEM-43, R35, F11-R3-07). Absence cue forms ('no <X>', 'without <X>', 'lacks <X>', 'failed to <X>') are card-quoted report phrases, not field markers
F11.blank: never (no empty value, empty string or empty 'key:'; SEM-50, A15, S4 renders; X17)
F11.missing_key: not stated (SEM-50): a missing key or column, only on cards with a missing rule for that attribute
stricter_bans: [], null, 'unknown' or 'not recorded' in a set field
refs: X17 / K29 (request for this row; closes M2)

F12.uses_notes: SEM-31: 'A field of a record or tool output marked "not recorded" or "unknown" gives no value'; never on a decisive precondition field (NG-03)
F12.local_notes: '0', 'no' and false are ordinary values, not missing-value markers; 'not given' (SEM-02) is a parameter status, not a rendered marker
F12.blank: never (records and tool outputs are closed: no empty cell, empty string or key with nothing after it; NG-04, R3-SC1)
F12.missing_key: a field that is not shown gives no value (SEM-02 field-name rule; not a marker)

F13.local_notes: one value marker per card, quoted in its SEM-01/02 world line; part trace form '<part label> (<scope label>): not included in this copy.'
F13.missing_key: not used (every attribute a rule reads is stated or traced, F13R1-07)
stricter_bans: 'pending' or 'not yet received' as a trace (statuses, SEM-48)
refs: 2.4 trace list TR (one value marker per card)
